patch_description: This design replaces broad two-hop rewards with a sparse, fixed-budget route-credit model. For each OD pair, it ranks relays using edge exposure and pressure-aware node availability, then distributes a capped incentive across only the two strongest two-hop alternatives. This avoids rewarding every possible relay independently. It also adds small, localized positive couplings between high-demand links sharing a tail or head, approximating endpoint crowding without creating a dense interaction graph. Relay availability uses the gentler pressure exponent suggested by the prior feedback.
